need.name: Client Dimension stewardship and ownership transfer
need.description: Represent a service provider administering a client organizational Dimension before the client adopts it, followed by explicit transfer of governance while preserving object identities and service-provider delegation. Distinguish represented organization, current administrator, accountable owner, acceptance state, delegated model installation and revocation.
questions: Who currently administers the Dimension and who may approve model installation?
How is client acceptance and ownership transfer recorded without cloning data?
